claude_proposed_widenings.name: block_state_transition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell prevents a corpse from becoming Undead — a deterministic mechanical block on a creature-type state transition. No v4 atom covers this. 'apply_condition' only applies SRD conditions; 'block_targeting' blocks spell targeting, not type changes. This is a new effect class.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target is protected from decay and can't become Undead

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment: object (corpse/remains)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell targets a corpse or remains, which is an object rather than a living creature. The v4 taxonomy lists 'object' as an attachment atom but it is absent from types.ts Attachment union (self | target | area | mark). Targeting a corpse cannot be honestly expressed as 'target' since that selection grammar assumes a living creature context.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch a corpse or other remains.
